title: Career Roadmap: Content Strategist
summary: Plan, develop and manage content that supports an organization's brand, audience engagement and business goals across websites, social media, blogs, email campaigns and other digital channels.

facts.Current degree: Liberal Arts / Liberal Studies (BA / B.Sc Liberal Arts & Sciences)

about.label: Education Pathway
about.text: Liberal Arts / Liberal Studies – Media, Communication & Culture

blocks.text: Plan, develop and manage content that supports an organization's brand, audience engagement and business goals across websites, social media, blogs, email campaigns and other digital channels.

rows.text: Any stream; develop writing, communication and research skills
Liberal Arts degree with a concentration in Media, Communication & Culture
Content strategy, digital marketing, brand communication, UX writing or editorial planning
Master's in Communication, Digital Media, Marketing or Media Management, where beneficial

blocks.label: Alternative pathways
blocks.text: BA Journalism, Mass Communication, English, Digital Media or Marketing, supported by practical content projects.

blocks.label: Content Planning
blocks.text: Content calendars, audience personas, editorial strategy and channel selection.

blocks.label: Writing & Editing
blocks.text: Headlines, blogs, website copy, social posts and brand messaging.

blocks.label: Research
blocks.text: Audience research, competitor analysis, keyword research and fact-checking.

blocks.label: Analytics
blocks.text: Website traffic, engagement, conversions, retention and content performance.

blocks.label: Digital Tools
blocks.text: Content management systems, SEO tools, spreadsheets and analytics dashboards.

blocks.label: AI Literacy
blocks.text: Use AI tools for ideation and research assistance while verifying facts and maintaining brand consistency.
Create three or four portfolio projects:

blocks.label: Content Strategy
blocks.text: Develop a 30-day content plan for a brand or organization.

blocks.label: Website Content Audit
blocks.text: Evaluate existing content and recommend improvements.

blocks.label: SEO Content Campaign
blocks.text: Plan and write a search-focused article cluster.

blocks.label: Social Media Campaign
blocks.text: Create content themes, post examples and measurable objectives.

blocks.label: Performance Report
blocks.text: Analyse sample content metrics and recommend next steps.
For each project, explain the audience, objective, content choices, distribution plan and success measures.
Target placements at:

items.text: Education, healthcare and nonprofit communication teams.

blocks.text: Search for Content Strategy Intern, Content Marketing Intern, Editorial Intern, SEO Content Intern and Digital Marketing Intern roles.
Prioritize:

items.text: Google Analytics or equivalent web analytics.
Content management systems and basic HTML.

blocks.text: Certifications can supplement your portfolio, but writing quality, strategic thinking and measurable outcomes are more important.
Content / Editorial Intern
Content Writer / Content Executive
Content Strategist
Senior Strategist → Content Lead / Head of Content
Progression depends on strategic ownership, editorial judgment, analytics skills and demonstrated impact on audience or business outcomes.

rows.text: Learn audience research, content planning, writing fundamentals and SEO basics.
Create a content calendar, write sample articles and complete a website content audit.
Build a portfolio, analyse content performance and apply for internships or junior content roles.

blocks.label: Target-ready profile
blocks.text: Strong writing and editing, audience research, content planning, SEO and analytics knowledge, supported by a portfolio that connects content decisions to measurable goals.
